title: Making the short film Deviled Hams
summary: He recalls his shaky film debut in white tails in 1937.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Now, I notice there was a film here that you did called Deviled Hams.
Can you tell us a little something about that?
Oh, boy. What year was it? What year?

I forgot the tune we played in that picture. But, I didn't have too much to do in it besides get in front of the band and blow my horn. And we had fun cause I had on white tails. I'll never forget that, you know.
And, who was the leader? Who was the star of that show, Deviled Hams? I know him well. I can't recall his name now.
But, that was what you called a short film?
Yeah. But, that was the first. We was nervous. We were shaking. We had to go through the action like we was playing. We had played it on record first, you know.
Right. It says 'A musical divertisement in a satyric setting featuring Hawkins Orchestra with Wilbur Bascomb.'
that was my film debut. Yeah, it was, it was kind of shaky for me cause, it was kind of, I didn't know about that with all them lights hitting you there.
